AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.description_1: I'm a developer who cares about both engineering quality and user experience. Beyond writing code, I enjoy turning complex business requirements into simple, reliable, and intuitive products — from internal enterprise systems to products used by real customers.
AboutSection.description_2: I have experience working independently as well as leading frontend teams, collaborating closely with designers, backend developers, product owners, and business stakeholders.
AboutSection.description_3: I also founded TespDev, an independent technology studio focused on building digital products and event technology for businesses. Currently, I work as a Software Engineer at Phuong Dong General Hospital, while continuing to develop TespDev and work with selected partners and clients.
